thread:
sam: quick heads-up — PR #1493 failing `gofmt` on CI only on windows runners (line ending diff). I pushed a tiny fix but it still shows as changed in workspace. blocking tomorrow's release if not merged. @alex @maria can you take a look?

alex: on it, will run `gofmt -w` locally and push a clean commit. suspect CRLF sneaked in from WSL.

maria: fyi saw one var name `respData` vs `resp` nit; not necessary to change but pinging in case you want consistency.

ci-bot: CI: linux-unit ✅ linux-integration ✅ windows-unit ❌ (gofmt) — https://ci.example/reports/1493

alex: repro'ed. quick fix: `git config core.autocrlf false && git checkout -- . && gofmt -w ./...` then re-add. pushing in 5.

sam: thanks. also need 1 approval from eng leads for merge window — @eli will you give :eyes: when green?

eli: will review after CI is green. prefer keeping the var rename separate if it's non-functional.

alex: pushed 1767777789 - fixed line endings and fmt. PTAL.

ci-bot: CI: windows-unit ✅ — gofmt clean. All green.

eli: approve — tiny change, okay to merge. :shipit:

maria: ack, skipping var rename for now. merge when you're ready.

sam: merging now to unblock release. thanks team.
